integration_constraints: Final selected IDs must be extracted from the unchanged independent issuing authorities, never allowed from dossier labels alone.

Do not attach propanal, butanal, isobutyraldehyde or an alternative nucleotide as an additional input of the exact balanced acetaldehyde route reaction. Keep activity preferences on the preparation-scoped catalyst evidence or separately verify an exact alternative reaction before modeling it.
Formaldehyde <2 nmol/min is an upper-bounded assay result, not absolute inability or inhibition; formate-assay formaldehyde is analytical product, not a pathway product.
Genetic induction does not demonstrate direct aromatic-compound binding to TbuS. Do not convert a tested noninducer to an inhibitor.
NADP and propionyl-CoA neutral/ionic structures remain explicit comparators. The paper redox name or HPLC assignment does not itself measure a unique phosphate protonation state.
Historical enol and hydroxyketo pools must remain stereounspecified where the preparation is unspecified. An unspecified stereocenter is not synonymous with racemate.
Buffers, purification reagents, analytical salts, synthetic precursors and crystal additives remain described context unless a separate supported mechanistic relation warrants a node.
The accepted pubchem-compound-property-json adapter uses Title only; preserve its exact acquisition bytes and whole CID structure proof. No adapter change is needed.
The formal 2Z/2E source SMILES omit a direction mark; complete issuing InChI/keys carry stereo. Do not reconstruct a historical geometry from those incomplete SMILES.
